paper.title: LightGBM: A Highly Efficient Gradient Boosting Decision Tree

paper_context.research_question: Can the released CPU implementation learn a fixed small public classification task?
paper_context.method: Fit 40 depth-three boosting iterations on a fixed Breast Cancer Wisconsin split.
paper_context.data_and_splits: Breast Cancer Wisconsin dataset distributed by scikit-learn; fixed stratified split.
paper_context.training_or_inference: 426 training observations, one CPU thread, no tuning.
paper_context.evaluation_protocol: One predeclared split; require accuracy no worse than 0.90.
paper_context.limitations: Smoke reproduction, not the paper's 20-times speedup or large-data benchmark.

claims.protocol: One predeclared split; require accuracy no worse than 0.90.
